title: business-plan
summary: Write, structure, and update a business plan for a solopreneur. Use when creating a plan from scratch, updating an existing plan after a pivot or new phase, or preparing a plan to share with investors, partners, or even just to clarify your own strategy. Covers executive summary, market analysis, competitive positioning, revenue model, operations plan, financial projections, and risk assessment — all adapted for a one-person business. Trigger on "write a business plan", "business plan", "create my plan", "business plan template", "update my business plan", "plan for my business", "investor pitch plan".
